summary: Verified Salt Spray History Pengamatan feature end-to-end. Backend (test_salt_obs_series.py, 1 test with 15+ assertions): active-summary, complete (409 pending / 400 empty / success all_reached / success stopped_early), header reset (conditions kept + per-run cleared), archived card PUT=409, list/detail, delete + 404, reopen (restores cards+header, 409 when active cards exist). Frontend UI: series-complete-banner shown on Kartu Pengamatan (all 4 samples 100% at 3 Jam), modal series-confirm with no warning, note textarea works, OK archives -> obs-empty shown. History page shows total/samples/done/avg stats correctly, series card lists SERI #3 with cover. Detail page shows title, header view, report table, progress-chart (recharts), gallery (4 photos), lightbox opens on photo click, PDF export fires without page errors, reopen confirm modal navigates back to Kartu Pengamatan with 4 cards restored & banner reappears. Final state verified via API: 4 real cards present, header operator='hendry' / start 2026-10-12 13:10 intact, 0 leftover test series.

issues: Recharts emits width/height=-1 warning on initial mount (ResponsiveContainer parent has no explicit min size yet). Non-blocking; chart still renders after layout.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py salt_series_complete numbering uses find_one({'reopened': {'$ne': True}}). Reopen sets reopened=True AND deleted_at, so numbering excludes reopened series but still counts soft-deleted (non-reopened) series. Current real series got #3 which suggests at least 2 prior non-reopened series existed in DB history before this run (acceptable).
ObsHistoryDetail: when lightbox is open, Escape key does not close it (only backdrop click). Minor UX note — not a bug.
RustProgressChart recharts warning: wrap ResponsiveContainer with a parent that has explicit min-h to silence console warnings.
seed_data_creation: During test: archived user's real 4-card series to History (via UI + via pytest), created 1 temp partial-coverage card for 409/force flow, then deleted temp series and reopened real series. End state verified identical to start: 4 real cards (hours 0/1/2/3), header operator=hendry start=2026-10-12 13:10, History list empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_salt_obs_series.py is self-contained & idempotent: snapshots state, archives real series, creates temp card, exercises 409/400/success, then reopens real series in finally. Safe to re-run. If REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL changes, test picks it up from env or /app/frontend/.env.
